name: sim_gap_taylor_tower_convergence_constraint_canonical
constraint: Analytic functor must have convergent Taylor tower P_n F → F

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of Taylor tower convergence constraint

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic computation for connectivity defect and convergence rate

test_1_polynomial_bounded_convergence.description: Polynomial functor with bounded degree has convergent Taylor tower

test_2_rational_finite_poles_convergence.description: Rational functor with finite pole set has convergent tower
test_2_rational_finite_poles_convergence.interpretation: Functors with finite singularities admit convergent towers

test_3_summable_error_tail_convergence.description: Functor with summable error tail has convergent Taylor tower

test_neg_1_infinite_defect_diverges.description: Functor with infinite connectivity defect has divergent tower

test_neg_2_non_summable_error_tail_diver.description: Functor with non-summable error tail has divergent tower
test_neg_2_non_summable_error_tail_diver.interpretation: Constant or slowly-decaying errors prevent convergence

test_neg_3_oscillating_no_limit_diverges.description: Oscillating approximations without single limit diverge
test_neg_3_oscillating_no_limit_diverges.interpretation: Oscillation without convergence is incompatible with analyticity

test_boundary_1_zero_defect_trivial_conv.description: Constant functor has zero defect and trivial tower convergence
test_boundary_1_zero_defect_trivial_conv.interpretation: Defect = 0 is the minimal convergent case

test_boundary_2_linear_decay_insufficien.description: Linear decay 1/n is insufficient for summability
test_boundary_2_linear_decay_insufficien.interpretation: Boundary between summable and non-summable decay rates

test_boundary_3_critical_degree_converge.description: Tower convergence threshold at degree n+1
test_boundary_3_critical_degree_converge.interpretation: The (n+1)-excisive stage is the critical convergence point
